name: NavBar
description: Top-level site navigation bar with logo, links, optional CTA, and a mobile menu trigger.

dos: Place one NavBar per page at the top of the layout.
Use variant=surface for pages with a light hero; use variant=transparent to overlay a dark/image hero.
Keep items to 5 or fewer to avoid overflow on medium screens.

donts.case: Nesting interactive components (dropdowns, tooltips) inside items
donts.why: NavBar does not manage overlay z-index or keyboard trap for nested overlays.

donts.case: Using NavBar as a secondary / in-page navigation
donts.why: NavBar is fixed to the viewport top and communicates site-level navigation.

related.difference: The CTA slot typically contains a Button. NavBar does not render a Button itself.

props.name: variant
props.description: surface = opaque card background + border. transparent = no background, used over hero images.

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand logo or wordmark. Rendered inside the logo slot on the left.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; href: string; active?: boolean }[]
props.description: Navigation links. Rendered as an <ul> on desktop; hidden on mobile until menuOpen=true.

props.name: cta
props.description: Optional call-to-action placed at the right of the bar. Typically a Button.

props.name: menuOpen
props.description: Controls mobile drawer visibility. Becomes visible below 768px breakpoint.

props.name: onMenuOpenChange
props.description: Callback fired when the mobile menu trigger is pressed.

controlled.name: menuOpen
controlled.description: Mobile drawer is open. Items become visible, trigger shows close icon.

root.description: Full-width sticky container. Spans viewport width.

inner.description: Max-width wrapper centered horizontally. Holds logo, nav, cta.

logo.description: Logo slot on the left side.

nav.description: Horizontal list of navigation items. Hidden on mobile.

items.description: List of NavItem links inside nav.

menuTrigger.description: Hamburger / close icon button. Visible only below 768px.

mobileDrawer.description: Mobile menu panel. Visible when menuOpen=true and viewport < 768px.

a11y.name: Site navigation
keyboard: Tab — move focus through links and CTA
Escape — close mobile drawer when menuOpen=true
a11y.contrastNote: color.foreground on color.card must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1)

label.voice: Short noun or noun phrase. 'Pricing', 'About us', 'Blog'.

behavior.overflow: Items truncate or wrap to mobile drawer when viewport < 768px.
responsive: < 768px: nav and cta hidden, menuTrigger visible
>= 768px: nav and cta visible, menuTrigger hidden

i18n.rtl: logo moves to right, items to left; drawer slides from left.
i18n.textExpansion: Items may wrap to 2 lines on medium screens with long translations.

cases: Renders logo, all items, and CTA on desktop
Items and CTA hidden on mobile (< 768px)
variant=transparent has no background or border
